title: LLM 사용량 (로컬)
description: LiteLLM 프록시를 거친 호출의 모델별 토큰·비용. 원본 표는 litellm DB 의 LiteLLM_SpendLogs. 설명은 infra/llm-usage/README.md.

list.name: key
list.label: 가상 키
list.query: select distinct metadata->>'user_api_key_alias' from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" where metadata->>'user_api_key_alias' is not null order by 1

list.name: tag
list.label: 실험 태그
list.query: select distinct t from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs", jsonb_array_elements_text(request_tags) t where t not like 'User-Agent%' order by 1

panels.title: 총 비용 (USD)

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(spend),0) as "비용" from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" where status = 'success' and $__timeFilter("startTime") and ('${tag}' = '__all' or jsonb_exists(request_tags, '${tag}')) and ('${key}' = '__all' or metadata->>'user_api_key_alias' = '${key}')

panels.description: LiteLLM 내장 단가표로 계산한 값. 실제 청구 금액은 OpenAI·Anthropic 대시보드가 원본이다. 로컬 모델(TEI)은 0.

panels.title: 총 입력 토큰

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(prompt_tokens),0) as "토큰" from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" where status = 'success' and $__timeFilter("startTime") and ('${tag}' = '__all' or jsonb_exists(request_tags, '${tag}')) and ('${key}' = '__all' or metadata->>'user_api_key_alias' = '${key}')

panels.description: 토크나이저가 회사·모델마다 달라 모델끼리 토큰 수를 바로 비교하지 않는다 — 같은 입력의 비용으로 비교한다.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as "호출" from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" where status = 'success' and $__timeFilter("startTime") and ('${tag}' = '__all' or jsonb_exists(request_tags, '${tag}')) and ('${key}' = '__all' or metadata->>'user_api_key_alias' = '${key}')

select count(*) as "실패" from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" where status <> 'success' and $__timeFilter("startTime") and ('${tag}' = '__all' or jsonb_exists(request_tags, '${tag}')) and ('${key}' = '__all' or metadata->>'user_api_key_alias' = '${key}')

select model_group as "모델", count(*) as "호출", sum(prompt_tokens) as "입력 토큰",
       sum(completion_tokens) as "출력 토큰", sum(spend) as "비용 (USD)",
       round(avg(request_duration_ms)) as "평균 지연 (ms)"
  from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" where status = 'success' and $__timeFilter("startTime") and ('${tag}' = '__all' or jsonb_exists(request_tags, '${tag}')) and ('${key}' = '__all' or metadata->>'user_api_key_alias' = '${key}')
 group by model_group order by "비용 (USD)" desc, "입력 토큰" desc

panels.title: 실험 태그 × 모델

targets.rawSql:
select t as "태그", model_group as "모델", count(*) as "호출", sum(prompt_tokens) as "입력 토큰",
       sum(spend) as "비용 (USD)"
  from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs", jsonb_array_elements_text(request_tags) t
 where status = 'success' and $__timeFilter("startTime") and ('${tag}' = '__all' or jsonb_exists(request_tags, '${tag}')) and ('${key}' = '__all' or metadata->>'user_api_key_alias' = '${key}') and t not like 'User-Agent%'
 group by t, model_group order by t, model_group

panels.description: 평가 도구는 x-litellm-tags 로 실험 이름(예: 012-embedding-pairs)과 후보 별칭을 붙인다.

panels.title: 실행(가상 키) × 모델

targets.rawSql:
select coalesce(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias', '(관리 키)') as "가상 키", model_group as "모델", count(*) as "호출",
       sum(prompt_tokens) as "입력 토큰", sum(completion_tokens) as "출력 토큰", sum(spend) as "비용 (USD)"
  from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" where status = 'success' and $__timeFilter("startTime") and ('${tag}' = '__all' or jsonb_exists(request_tags, '${tag}')) and ('${key}' = '__all' or metadata->>'user_api_key_alias' = '${key}')
 group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2

panels.description: 012 재클러스터링은 실행마다 가상 키(sk-012-run-<별칭>)를 따로 써서, 임베딩 채우기와 LLM 폴백(gpt-4o-mini) 비용이 키별로 나뉜다.

targets.rawSql:
select $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", 1h), model_group as metric, sum(spend) as value
  from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" where status = 'success' and $__timeFilter("startTime") and ('${tag}' = '__all' or jsonb_exists(request_tags, '${tag}')) and ('${key}' = '__all' or metadata->>'user_api_key_alias' = '${key}') group by 1, 2 order by 1

select $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", 1h), model_group as metric, sum(prompt_tokens) as value
  from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" where status = 'success' and $__timeFilter("startTime") and ('${tag}' = '__all' or jsonb_exists(request_tags, '${tag}')) and ('${key}' = '__all' or metadata->>'user_api_key_alias' = '${key}') group by 1, 2 order by 1

select "startTime" as "시각(UTC)", coalesce(nullif(model_group, ''), '(모델 없음)') as "모델", status as "상태",
       left(coalesce(metadata->>'error_information', metadata::text), 200) as "내용"
  from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" where status <> 'success' and $__timeFilter("startTime") and ('${tag}' = '__all' or jsonb_exists(request_tags, '${tag}')) and ('${key}' = '__all' or metadata->>'user_api_key_alias' = '${key}')
 order by "startTime" desc limit 50
